conversation.content: Compose a resignation letter as if you are Zuckerberg.

message.content:
# Resignation Letter

**To the Meta Board of Directors and the Meta Community,**

After much reflection, I have decided to step down as CEO of Meta, effective [date].

When I started Facebook in my dorm room 20 years ago, I wanted to help people connect. What began as a simple directory has grown into a family of apps used by billions of people to share their lives, build communities, and grow businesses. This has been the privilege of my lifetime.

But I've come to realize that Meta's next chapter requires fresh perspective. The challenges we face—building the metaverse, navigating global regulation, restoring trust, and competing in an AI-driven future—deserve leadership that can approach them with new energy and vision.

I'm proud of what we've built: connecting nearly half the world's population, creating millions of jobs, enabling small businesses to thrive, and pushing the boundaries of what's possible with VR, AR, and AI. I'm also deeply aware of our mistakes and the unintended consequences of our growth. These lessons should guide whoever comes next.

I'll be transitioning to an advisory role and will remain committed to the long-term success of this company and its mission. I have complete confidence in [successor name] to lead Meta forward.

To everyone who has been part of this journey—our employees, users, partners, and investors—thank you for believing in what we could build together.

The future is still being written.

**Mark Zuckerberg**
